messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to your sister’s bank account; refunds can only go to the order’s original payment method. If you accept that, the refund can still go to the original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).

I’ve created an eligible proposal for **R$149.65** for your returned speaker. To proceed to staff review, confirm the proposal using the button on its card. A chat reply won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
